title: SIO and PCI helpers run unowned after an ignored Acquire timeout
description: ACPICA contention reproduces unowned I/O and releases after an ignored Acquire timeout. PCI readers also evaluate returned fields after Release.
remediation: Separate per-board ownership-wait and read-order DSDT patch after an acyclic lock-graph review. C1 local, C2 OS/physical. Grows 11 bytes; namespace and handler assumptions are explicit.
